title: THE OVERSEER BY NAME IN A PARTY
why: When THE OVERSEER went down in a party the kill feed said WARDEN, and only the host window said it is down and its hoard is open: the teammate saw the hoard appear with no word. The feed now names the boss, and a linked window that sees it go down says the same line the host does.
now: THE OVERSEER in a party: the kill feed names it, and both windows say when it is down and its hoard is open.

edits.replacement: var who=((e.kind==='raider'||e.boss)&&e.name)?netClean(e.name,24):String(e.kind||'').toUpperCase();   // v16.xx: the boss by its name

edits.anchor: try{ deathAnimAdd(e); }catch(_dz){}   // v17.47: his pick 29, the death animation in a linked window
